invariants.ownership: The conversation must belong to the CEO principal derived from the validated session.
invariants.correlation: Events are joined only through persisted identifiers and foreign-key relationships, never matching text or timestamps.
invariants.content_exclusion: Conversation bodies and decision rationales are excluded from this read model.
invariants.missing_sources: Each unsupported source is returned with an explicit non-available status; no absence is represented as success.
invariants.authority: The route is read-only and cannot authorize assignment, execution, mutation, a provider request, or an external action.
